{"consolidated_memory":"SEARCH/QUERY/REWRITER.TS: THREE EMPTY RESULT SET INCIDENTS

This file (search/query/rewriter.ts, search side) has experienced the same symptom—empty result set with rewritten query containing no clauses—across three separate occasions with different root causes:

OCCASION 1 - [2026-02-21]
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Repro: Search for two-word phrase with stop word
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Signal: Rewritten query with no clauses left
- Fix: Made default empty and built value per call
- PR #3598, branch fix/empty-result-set-1
- Outcome: Flaky test improved from 37 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2 - [2026-05-02]
- Trigger: After rolling restart of fleet
- Repro: Search for two-word phrase with stop word
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Signal: Rewritten query with no clauses left
- Fix: Invalidated cache entry inside write transaction
- PR #4143, branch fix/empty-result-set-2
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 8.1% to under 1 per 10,000

OCCASION 3 - [2026-08-17]
- Trigger: Only manifested on staging read replica
- Repro: Search for two-word phrase with stop word
- Root cause: Schema drift between migration and model
- Signal: Rewritten query with no clauses left
- Fix: Regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #8902, branch fix/empty-result-set-3
- Test file: search/query/rewriter.test.ts
- Stack: TypeScript
- Outcome: Memory settled at 140 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB

All three incidents share the same corner of search/query/rewriter.ts, allowing context to carry over between fixes."}
